notes: Verifiers confirmed: 187 offices, 4,552 m² office area, 569 workstations; 403 staff; 8 boards; plans each floor separately; JPG/TIFF 300 dpi ≤100 MB per file; boards in Polish.

Jury personas mirror the real composition of the Court: SARP chair (overall quality), SARP referee (function & compliance), City Architect (urban fit & heritage), Marshal/Secretary (client: dignity, operation, budget), expert (zero-emission, accessibility, cost).
Scoring: 5 primary criteria equal weight + secondary cost at half weight, plus Borda count from rankings; the winner gets weaknesses removed and best ideas grafted from the others.

Drawing engine demo (right): double-loaded office wing, 1.35 m module, 3-workstation rooms, meeting room, core with stair & lifts — the same engine will produce every floor plan with room numbers/areas consistent with table F.15.B.
